notes.title: Update Notes for 1/1/2024
notes.notes: Just a quick update today - the best time screen has been formatted to match the time display in game instead of showing only a seconds count.

notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.notes:
Cydoku Patch 1.5 is now live!

This is the first significant patch release for Cydoku and contains the following changes:

    1. Adjustments made to difficulty schedule of playfields.
    2. Incorrect highlighting available via a new playfield button.
    3. New animations to utility graphics
    4. Settings and Preferences changes now trigger save button animation.

Patch 2.0 is moving toward completion - looking forward to expanding the Cydoku experience with Leader boards, Achievements, and competition play!
